Name: Beyond Tuning
Description: Car Tuning with engine-specific Drift/Race examples, multiplayer calibration and live telemetry, a folding portable laptop, persistent tunes and optional BA nitrous.
Changelog: Closed laptops use native Remove on a mount and Take on the ground. Beyond Apocalypse backpacks show Tuner Laptop with a dedicated icon. Exiting fullscreen restores controls even if the screen snapshot fails.
